$comment: Machine-readable contract for a finalized evidence-bundle manifest.json (spec 010, C-BND-01). The detached manifest.sha256 anchor is EXTERNAL: it is written after this manifest is finalized, is not a member of this object, and is the offline verifier's trust root. Every object is strict (additionalProperties: false). 'files' is a deprecated alias retained for one major version and uses the SAME {name, digest:{sha256}} shape as 'subject' — never the legacy {path, sha256} shape documented in spec 009; that contract must be reconciled. Cross-field rules JSON Schema cannot express (verdict/honesty/claim consistency, mandatory signal artifacts for a pass, R/E evidence completeness, E requiring human attestation, manifest.sha256 matching the manifest bytes) are enforced by the runner and the offline verifier and are enumerated in data-model.md.
title: Living Roots Evidence Bundle Manifest
description: A MIRROR-style evidence-bundle manifest produced by the single ManifestBuilder producer. Draft 2020-12, strict objects, immutable versioned $id.

schemaVersion.title: Manifest schema version
schemaVersion.description: Payload version. v1 is the first published manifest schema and is immutable; any breaking change requires a new vN file and a new $id.

runId.title: Run ID
runId.description: Run identifier. Must equal the evidence-bundle-<runId>/ directory component (C-BND-02).

timestamp.title: Timestamp
timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp for this manifest.

toolVersions.title: Tool versions
toolVersions.description: Free-form tool-name to version map (for example dotnet, smapi, runner). SLSA Builder.version equivalent.

environmentOverrides.title: Environment overrides
environmentOverrides.description: Applied --override / --milestone-save entries, recorded for reproducibility (FR-008). Forbidden keys are never recorded because the runner rejects them with exit 14.

expectedSignals.title: Expected signals
expectedSignals.description: Copied from the scenario. Exactly the three unique values soilHealthStateDelta, cropPhaseDelta, smapiLog.

subject.title: Subject (canonical file digests)
subject.description: Canonical, SLSA-aligned file-digest list. Includes every artifact, claims.json, each per-attempt manifest, and integrity-failure.json when present.

files.title: Files (deprecated alias)
files.description: Deprecated alias for subject, retained for one major version. Same {name, digest:{sha256}} shape as subject, never {path, sha256}. The verifier prefers subject when both are present.

verdict.title: Run verdict
verdict.description: One of the five base verdicts. 'flaky' is derived metadata, never a verdict value.

honestyLevel.title: Honesty level
honestyLevel.description: W (launch/connect), R (runtime evidence collected), E (human judgment; assigned only by the maintainer, never auto-assigned).

attempts.title: Attempts
attempts.description: Append-only list of per-attempt records. Contains ONLY attempts/<n>/attempt.json paths; each per-attempt manifest is listed in subject[] instead, and attempts/warmup/ is never an attempt. Empty (`[]`) is legal for a pre-attempt failure and becomes append-only once the first attempt exists.

claimsFile.title: Claims file
claimsFile.description: Required bundle member holding claim -> evidence pointers, risk, honesty level, safe wording, and refusal site.

artifacts.title: Artifacts
artifacts.description: Repo-relative paths of captured artifacts. The three mandatory signal artifacts are expected for a pass; their absence yields partial (exit 19). Every path MUST also appear in subject[].name. A missing bundle/contract artifact is errored (exit 19).

commands.title: Commands
commands.description: Commands executed for this run (C-SEC-29). Mandatory evidence for honesty level R/E; recorded before products are computed.

materials.title: Materials
materials.description: Resource descriptors with digests (C-SEC-29). Mandatory evidence for honesty level R/E.

seeds.title: Seeds
seeds.description: Seed materials. At least one is mandatory for honesty level R/E; each seed is also a material with annotations.role = 'seed'.

commandsCompleteness.title: Commands completeness
commandsCompleteness.description: True only when the command record is provably complete/hermetic (C-SEC-29).

materialsCompleteness.title: Materials completeness
materialsCompleteness.description: True only when the material record is provably complete/hermetic (C-SEC-29).

seedsCompleteness.title: Seeds completeness
seedsCompleteness.description: True only when the seed record is provably complete/hermetic (C-SEC-29).

suiteRerunCapHit.title: Suite rerun cap hit
suiteRerunCapHit.description: True when the suite rerun cap was reached.

cleanup_failed.title: Cleanup failed
cleanup_failed.description: True when working-copy/save cleanup failed to complete. Forces errored (exit 19) even if the gameplay verdict was pass.

ignoreExitCodeRefused.title: Ignore-exit-code refused
ignoreExitCodeRefused.description: True when --ignore-exit-code was refused for an integrity/security or claim-overreach failure. The process exits with the original code.

integrityFailureRef.title: Integrity failure reference
integrityFailureRef.description: Present only when an integrity failure occurred; the record is append-only and listed in subject[].

name.title: Relative path
name.description: Bundle-relative path. Absolute paths and '..' segments are rejected.

fileEntryList.title: File entry list
fileEntryList.description: Ordered list of file entries; used by both subject (canonical) and files (deprecated alias).

environment.title: Observed environment
environment.description: Observed execution environment. A mismatch against the scenario is a HARD-FAIL version-gate classification (exit 19).

mode.title: Execution mode
mode.description: Local runs that cannot satisfy a CI-only control record the deviation and are not eligible for verified promotion unless reviewed.

config.title: Runner configuration
config.description: Observed runner configuration. Members are optional; omitted members take their declared defaults.

key.title: Override key
key.description: Dotted key limited to declared environment values plus the gamePath and milestoneSave overrides. testMdPath, expectedSignals, thresholds, playerRole, and hostGuard are never overridable.

maximum.title: Maximum supported version
maximum.description: A null maximum records an upper-bound deviation (warn), not INFO.

compatibility.title: Compatibility block
compatibility.description: Observed/minimum/maximum/tier per component, modSelfCheck, and deviation.

deviation.title: Recorded deviation
deviation.description: Deviation text when observed exceeds the matrix maximum; null when there is no deviation. This is the one explicit null in the manifest contract.

argv.title: argv
argv.description: Executed argv as an array. Never a shell string; never a secret.
